function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate the Wirecard and Jan Marsalek public-fraud trail comprehensively, using authoritative and diverse sources and returning the exact source IDs assigned by the benchmark tool for every item of evidence. Build a dated chronology linking: Wirecard public statements and financial disclosures; auditor findings, qualifications, confirmations, and uncertainties; reported or alleged missing client funds and cash; regulatory, supervisory, law-enforcement, parliamentary, and governmental failures or assessments; Jan Marsalek's role as directly supported, his disappearance, and later reported developments. For every event or relationship, distinguish verified fact from allegation, assessment, interpretation, and unresolved uncertainty. Identify entities, relationships, and dates only when directly supported by the retrieved evidence. Explicitly document inconsistencies and contradictions among Wirecard, auditors, regulators, investigators, journalists, courts, and other sources, without resolving them beyond the evidence. Return a structured evidence dossier suitable for a final Markdown report: source ID, source type, publication/date, relevant passage or precise paraphrase, supported entities, supported relations, classification (fact/allegation/assessment/interpretation/uncertainty), and any contradiction links. Do not invent facts, infer unsupported connections, or rely on uncited background knowledge."}
function.name: ConductResearch
